profile.funding_status: Series G closed at $30B on a $380B post-money valuation (Feb 2026), led by Coatue and GIC with additional funding from Microsoft and Nvidia

profile.summary: Anthropic is a San Francisco-based AI safety and research company founded in 2021 that sells access to its Claude models and agent tools, mainly through API and enterprise contracts. It closed a $30B Series G at a $380B post-money valuation in February 2026 and has filed publicly for an IPO, with pricing reportedly expected in November 2026. Recent activity includes expanded Amazon and Google/Broadcom compute partnerships and a $1.5B enterprise AI services joint venture.

profile.summary: Airbnb is a public lodging marketplace headquartered in San Francisco, founded in 2007, and listed on Nasdaq as ABNB, with approximately 8,200 employees at the end of 2025.
